name: Tooltip
description: Non-interactive floating text hint anchored to a trigger element

content.description: Floating content. Empty content leaves the trigger without a layer. Tooltip content must be noninteractive.

children.description: One trigger element forwarding props/ref, or text rendered as a Button.

open.description: Controlled visibility. Changes from the parent do not emit onOpenChange.

defaultOpen.description: Initial uncontrolled visibility; later changes do not reset the layer.

side.description: Preferred side; may flip when the opposite side has more room.

align.description: Logical alignment on the cross axis, following dir or the trigger's direction.

sideOffset.description: Additional nonnegative gap in pixels before the content membrane.

dir.description: Content direction. Omitted inherits the trigger; auto follows the content.

openDelay.description: Hover/focus opening delay in milliseconds (0–2147483647); default 200.

closeDelay.description: Closing delay after hover and focus leave (0–2147483647); default 0.

notes: The trigger retains its existing aria-describedby IDs and adds the tooltip ID. Pointer hover over trigger or content and trigger focus keep it open.
A native disabled button supports pointer hover but cannot receive keyboard focus; essential help also needs a visible or focusable location.
Tooltip is the non-interactive hover variant of Overlay.
Tooltip uses Button-compatible control padding and a 240px max width, then wraps copy instead of truncating.
sideOffset is the gap from the trigger border box to the content membrane. The visible surface adds the membrane inset.
Tooltip background and border are aliases of the shared overlay/dropdown surface tokens.
Tooltip copy must stay brief; use Popover for interactive or rich content.
